notes: Investigated thoroughly, no genuine Bestsellers PLP exists on xxxlutz.de. Checked: (1) Main nav / homepage - found a 'Topseller' TAB on the homepage 'Produkthighlights' widget, but it is a Coveo algorithmic recommendation carousel (productProvider=COVEO_RECOMMENDATIONS, minShown=4/maxShown=20) whose 'Topseller entdecken' link points to /s/?s=&sort=ga_itemquantity_desc - a live SEARCH-results endpoint (robots.txt explicitly Disallow: /s/) sorted by sales quantity, not a stable/browsable category PLP with its own product count - excluded per brief S3 (search-results pages excluded) and S5. (2) Site's own eyecatcher-badge registry (used for facet chips like 'Neu'/'Abverkauf' on every category page) was extracted in full from GraphQL SSR data - codes present: birthday, blackfriday, blueshopping, cybermonday, highend, liveshopping, new, online, primetime, redshopping, saisonabverkauf, sale, sale1l/1s/1u (all label 'Abverkauf'), singledays, special_offer, summersale, trend, wintersale, xxxlutztipp - NO bestseller/topseller/meistverkauft code exists, and no category page exposes a 'sort by bestseller/popularity' option. (3) Guessed direct URLs /bestseller, /bestsellers, /topseller, /meistverkauft, /beliebte-produkte, /c/bestseller, /c/topseller all return the bare client-side SPA shell (~4.5KB, identical across 8 retries with 5 rotated curl_cffi browser profiles) - confirmed as non-existent routes by contrast with a known-good category URL (/gartenmoebel-C8) which renders full SSR (~1.3-1.5MB) reliably. (4) Site's own search for 'Bestseller' returned only 1 irrelevant hit (title 'Treffer fuer Bestseller'), not a curated listing. (5) sitemap-categories.xml (5674 URLs) grepped for bestsell/topseller/meistverkauf/beliebt - zero matches. Conclusion: this site has no dedicated/navigable Bestsellers merchandising PLP; the only bestseller-adjacent surface is a homepage algorithmic widget backed by a disallowed search endpoint, which fails the PLP test.
